scope: PDF only. No manuscript source, experimental records, prior reviews or external bibliography accessed.
extraction: Poppler pdftohtml -xml -i -zoom 1 -stdout; pdftotext -raw for ordered citation-range expansion.
interpretation_notes: All Arabic digit characters in all PDF XML text nodes are covered exactly once by Arabic-digit token records.
This is an occurrence inventory, not a unique-value list. A split scientific notation or page range can occupy several tokens.
Literal text, precise XML node context, bounding box and source offset are retained. Signs and units are in node_text/context.
Spelled number words/quantifiers and roman table/section labels are supplemental records, including potentially nonnumeric ordinary-language uses.
Semantic categories are rule-assisted triage, not independent validation of measurements. Low confidence categories need their preserved context.
Bibliography pages are included; bibliographic dates, volumes, pages, citation labels and identifiers are not empirical results.
A citation range records printed endpoints in occurrences; citation_crosscheck separately expands interior reference numbers.
Percentages/intervals/means lack raw values except where displayed counts allow arithmetic consistency; this inventory does not certify raw results.
